newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom sold at average 1,733.17 rbls.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom sold at average 1,733.17 rbls.

text.p: A total of 1.01 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom changed hands on Wednesday at an average 1,733.17 roubles a share in the first electronic trading session organised by the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK), the FFK said.
At a cash auction organised on December 4 by the FFK, 8.75 million shares were sold at an average 1,807.14 roubles.
Full details of the electronic trading:
Total shares traded 1.01 million
Opening price (roubles) 1,780
Closing price 1,745
Maximum price 1,780
Minimum price 1,700
Average price 1,733.17
Number of lots traded 101
Total volume traded (million rbls) 1,750.5

The next electronic trading session will be held on December 18, when the FFK is also holding a conventional auction in which 10 million shares in 40 lots will be offered at price not exceeding 1,968 roubles a share.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company organised the auctions starting in March this year to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom shares are traded in Russia in the Russian Trading System (RTS), a local version of NASDAQ, but traders there require Gazprom's permission to sell shares.
The new electronic system gives traders the right to buy shares without asking Gazprom for permission.
The new system will only trade shares which have been sold at the cash auctions organised by the FFK.
Gazprom was not traded on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System by 1220 GMT, but was quoted at $0.315/$0.329, after closing at $0.320 on Tuesday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $17.575 after $17.67. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
